name: Topkey Corporation
summary: Topkey Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, produces, processes, sells, and trades in sporting goods in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through Sports Goods, Aviation, and Medical Products segments. The company offers glass and carbon fiber products; composite materials; glasses; and helmets, lenses, and automotive/motorcycle, and safety equipment. It also provides agency services; designs, develops, manufactures, and sells precision molds, as well as production and processing of water-resistant and moldless labels; processes plastic and rubber products; and engages in international investment and trade activities.
